projectContext.description: voiceover-matcher-subtitle: AI-powered pipeline for matching voiceover to stock footage

userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for rate-limiting focus area
acceptanceCriteria: Read scripts/ralph/config/ralph-config.json to understand the 'rate-limiting' focus area
Read scripts/ralph/session/prompt.md for project context and architecture notes
Read scripts/ralph/state/queue.json for interview details (story outline, architecture decisions, key files)
Read CLAUDE.md for project conventions and known issues
Analyze the codebase to find 8-12 specific improvements for 'rate-limiting'
Add stories US-41-002 through US-41-012 to scripts/ralph/state/prd.json (MUST use sprint-prefixed IDs)
Each story MUST have 4-6 testable acceptance criteria
Each story MUST have a 'notes' field with: (1) tier classification, (2) exact source file paths, (3) line number ranges if removing/moving code
IMPORTANT: All generated stories MUST have passes set to false - do NOT run tests or evaluate whether they already pass
IMPORTANT: Story IDs MUST follow format US-41-NNN to be unique across sprints
Mark this story (US-41-001) as passes: true when done
userStories.notes: Generated 11 stories (US-41-002 through US-41-012) addressing the two critical bugs from user logs: (1) text_metadata AttributeError after caption fetch, (2) retry budget exhaustion at 100/100 for 175 video batch despite auto_scale=true

userStories.title: Fix PipelineState text_metadata AttributeError on checkpoint restore
acceptanceCriteria: Add defensive hasattr() check before state.text_metadata.extend() in _populate_text_metadata()
Log warning when text_metadata attribute is missing and auto-initialize it
Add unit test that loads checkpoint with missing text_metadata and verifies graceful handling
Verify caption stage completes without AttributeError when state has no text_metadata attribute
Test passes with: pytest tests/test_stages/test_caption_stage.py -v -k text_metadata
userStories.notes: Tier: T1 (Critical Bug Fix). FIXED: Updated logger.debug to logger.warning with US-41-002 marker. Added TestCaptionStageTextMetadataCheckpointRestore class with 3 tests covering legacy state, SimpleNamespace, and warning logging. All 9 text_metadata tests pass.

userStories.title: Investigate and fix retry budget not scaling for large batches
acceptanceCriteria: Add INFO log at caption stage start showing: batch_size, max_attempts (before scaling), auto_scale setting
Add INFO log after ensure_scaled() showing: whether scaling occurred, new max_attempts value
Verify logs show 'scaled max_attempts from 100 to 350' for batch of 175 videos
Add test: batch of 175 with auto_scale=true should scale to 175*2.0=350 max_attempts
Verify budget exhaustion doesn't occur before video 100 for batch of 175
userStories.notes: Tier: T1 (Critical Bug). FIXED: Added US-41-003 INFO logs in caption_stage.py showing budget state BEFORE and AFTER ensure_scaled(). Added TestCaptionRetryBudgetLargeBatchScaling test class with 6 tests covering: scaling to 350, no exhaustion before video 100, processing all 175 videos, log message verification, idempotency, and auto_scale=false behavior.

userStories.title: Add retry budget scaling verification at batch start
acceptanceCriteria: After ensure_scaled() call, verify max_attempts >= batch_size * attempts_per_video
If verification fails, raise ValueError with actionable message including config path
Add config validation in CaptionRetryBudgetConfig.__post_init__ for attempts_per_video > 0
Log WARNING if auto_scale=false and batch_size > max_attempts
Add test: verification raises ValueError when scaling math is wrong
userStories.notes: Tier: T2 (Defensive). FIXED: Added verify_budget_sufficient() method in retry_budget.py:843-876 that validates max_attempts >= batch_size * attempts_per_video after ensure_scaled(). Raises ValueError with actionable message including config.yaml path when insufficient. Added __post_init__ validation for attempts_per_video > 0 in download.py:215-222. Logs WARNING when auto_scale=false and batch_size > max_attempts. Added 8 tests across TestCaptionRetryBudgetVerification and TestCaptionRetryBudgetConfigValidation classes. Commit: ae80a8f

userStories.title: Add per-video attempt counting to diagnose budget consumption
acceptanceCriteria: Track attempts_per_video_id: Dict[str, int] in CaptionRetryBudget
Log WARNING when any single video consumes >3 attempts (indicates retry loop)
Add get_high_attempt_videos(threshold=3) method returning video IDs with >threshold attempts
Include high_attempt_videos in budget summary when count > 0
Add test: video with 5 attempts appears in get_high_attempt_videos(3)
userStories.notes: Tier: T2 (Observability). FIXED: Added attempts_per_video_id tracking dict to CaptionRetryBudget. record_attempt() tracks per-video counts and logs WARNING when crossing 4 attempts (logs once per video). get_high_attempt_videos(threshold=3) returns video IDs sorted by attempt count descending. get_summary() includes high_attempt_videos when count > 0. Added 11 tests in TestCaptionRetryBudgetPerVideoAttemptTracking class. Commit: d468b91

userStories.title: Add circuit breaker trip count to budget exhaustion logging
acceptanceCriteria: Add circuit_breaker_trips: int counter to CaptionRetryBudget
Increment when circuit breaker trips (record_circuit_trip method)
Include circuit_breaker_trips in get_summary() output
Log INFO showing trips when budget exhausts with >0 trips
Add test: budget summary includes circuit_breaker_trips field
userStories.notes: Tier: T2 (Observability). FIXED: Added circuit_breaker_trips: int field, record_circuit_trip() method, included trips in get_summary() and to_dict()/from_dict(). budget_exhausted() logs INFO with trip count when >0. Added 9 tests in TestCaptionRetryBudgetCircuitBreakerTrips class covering: initial value, increment, summary inclusion, serialization, reset, and exhaustion logging.

userStories.title: Add defensive state validation before _populate_text_metadata
acceptanceCriteria: Call state.validate_state_attributes() at start of _populate_text_metadata()
If validation initializes fields, log WARNING with field names
Handle case where state is not a PipelineState instance (isinstance check)
If state lacks validate_state_attributes method, manually initialize text_metadata
Add test: _populate_text_metadata handles mock state object without text_metadata
userStories.notes: Tier: T1 (Defensive). Files: src/stages/caption_stage.py:1050-1060, src/state.py:179-207. Belt-and-suspenders defense: validate state attributes at usage point, not just creation.

userStories.title: Log retry budget state before and after checkpoint restore
acceptanceCriteria: Log INFO before checkpoint restore: 'Retry budget before restore: max_attempts=X, batch_size=Y'
Log INFO after checkpoint restore: 'Retry budget after restore: max_attempts=X, batch_size=Y, attempts_used=Z'
Log WARNING if restored budget has attempts > 0 but batch_size is None (indicates old checkpoint)
Include these logs in caption_stage.py initialization block
Add test: checkpoint restore logging shows expected values
userStories.notes: Tier: T2 (Observability). Files: src/stages/caption_stage.py:286-310. The logs from user show 100/100 exhaustion but no scaling, suggesting checkpoint restored an unscaled budget. More logging helps diagnose.

userStories.title: Add retry budget reset option when auto_scale triggers
acceptanceCriteria: Add config option reset_on_scale: bool = false to CaptionRetryBudgetConfig
When ensure_scaled() scales up AND reset_on_scale=true, reset attempts/failures counters
Log INFO when reset occurs: 'Budget scaled and reset: {attempts} attempts cleared'
Default to false to preserve existing behavior
Add test: ensure_scaled with reset_on_scale=true clears counters
userStories.notes: Tier: T3 (Enhancement). Files: src/caption/retry_budget.py:25-65, src/caption/retry_budget.py:780-842. If checkpoint restored with 50 attempts already used and batch needs 300, user may want to reset on scale-up.

userStories.title: Add batch progress percentage to budget exhaustion logs
acceptanceCriteria: Include videos_processed/batch_size in EXHAUSTED log message
Format: 'EXHAUSTED at 57% progress (100/175 videos processed)'
Add progress_percentage property to CaptionRetryBudget
Include progress_percentage in get_summary() output
Add test: progress_percentage returns correct value
userStories.notes: Tier: T3 (UX). Files: src/caption/retry_budget.py:255-282. The current log shows 100/100 attempts but user needs to know it happened at 57% through the batch to understand severity.

userStories.title: Add config validation for retry budget minimum values
acceptanceCriteria: Add __post_init__ to CaptionRetryBudgetConfig with validation
Validate: max_attempts >= 10 or max_attempts == 0 (unlimited)
Validate: attempts_per_video >= 1.0
Validate: max_backoff_time_seconds >= 30.0 or == 0 (unlimited)
Raise ValueError with helpful message if validation fails
userStories.notes: Tier: T3 (Defensive). Files: src/caption/retry_budget.py:25-65. Prevents misconfiguration like max_attempts=5 for 175 videos which guarantees failure.

userStories.title: Add checkpoint integrity check for retry budget batch_size
acceptanceCriteria: When restoring retry_budget from checkpoint, compare stored batch_size with current batch_size
Log WARNING if batch_size changed: 'Checkpoint batch_size (X) differs from current (Y)'
If current batch_size > restored batch_size, force re-scale even if already scaled
Add test: batch_size change triggers re-scale
Include batch_size_changed: bool in restored budget summary
userStories.notes: Tier: T2 (Defensive). Files: src/stages/caption_stage.py:286-310, src/caption/retry_budget.py:780-842. If checkpoint was from batch of 50 but current batch is 175, the restored max_attempts=100 is insufficient.
